summary: One endpoint that feeds the Overview screen: `GET /dashboard/summary` returns KPIs, 7-day and 24-hour trends, risk distributions, top signals, map data and recent activity in a single response. All the aggregation happens in `dashboard_summary` in `iip/queries.py`.

notes.text: Module docstring: aggregates for the overview screen.
Postpones evaluation of type hints (they are kept as strings); FastAPI still resolves them when it inspects each endpoint's signature.
The query function that computes the whole dashboard payload.
Registers `GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary`; the summary text lists what the payload contains.
A thin endpoint: FastAPI injects a session through `db: DB`, and one call to `dashboard_summary` returns everything, so the overview page loads with a single request.
